import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "/home/user/RampUpAndDown.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active

# Read headers
header_a = ws["A1"].value
header_b = ws["B1"].value
header_c = ws["C1"].value
header_d = ws["D1"].value
print("Headers:", header_a, "|", header_b, "|", header_c, "|", header_d)

# Fill B3:B30 with the same formula as B2 (adjusting row references)
for row in range(3, 31):
    ws[f"B{row}"] = f"=9.8*((A{row}-0.75*SIN(RADIANS(45))-0.25*0.75*COS(RADIANS(45)))/(A{row}+0.75))"
    ws[f"D{row}"] = f"=-9.8*((-C{row}+0.75*SIN(RADIANS(45))-0.25*0.75*COS(RADIANS(45)))/(C{row}+0.75))"

# Add Combined Data column header in E1
ws["E1"] = "Combined Data"

# Add formula for E2:E30 that concatenates values with headers
for row in range(2, 31):
    formula = (
        f'=A1&": "&TEXT(A{row},"0.00")&", "'
        f'&B1&": "&TEXT(B{row},"0.00")&", "'
        f'&C1&": "&TEXT(C{row},"0.00")&", "'
        f'&D1&": "&TEXT(D{row},"0.00")'
    )
    ws[f"E{row}"] = formula

wb.save(path)
print("Saved.")
